text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, on a video streaming site, I 
found a stage play that my mother 
performed in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I ended up watching it over and over, and 
before I knew it, morning had already 
come.
choice_data_list:
You really love your mother's stage 
performances, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The sound and intensity are 
different from a live show, but videos 
have their own charm... *yawn*.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I really need to stop staying up so 
late. I'll make sure I'm wide awake by the 
time training starts.
